answer: In this PoA design, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust matrix, while temporal decay halves reputation at a fixed exponential half-life, so influence requires sustained, honest service rather than a brief burst. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted paths and reciprocal history, they cannot pass the consensus threshold. Whether labeled plume, atlas, or pigment, a new identity cannot bypass that graph-derived constraint.
